title: Cal, hitchhiker

greeting.text: The bell. A hitchhiker with a pack and no coat, dry as a bone after all that fog.
Evening. Don't get up. I'm not buying. I only came to see how you two were getting on.

annoyed: You don't need to check me. You know what I am. That's the joke.

notes.wrist: He offers them before you ask. Veins, blue, unhurried.
notes.reflection: His back, in the mirror. Keep watching. Give it a few seconds.
notes.shadow: One shadow. He has had practice.

topics.answer: No. But I know the work. Three weeks, and nobody down the hill has noticed. That's craft, that is.
Oh. Oh, you've done the forgetting as well. They said one of you had. That is commitment.
topics.note: Wren has stopped polishing the glass they were polishing.

topics.ask: Your reflection just smiled at me.
topics.answer: Did it? It likes you. So do I.

wren.arrive: Not this one. Sam. Don't talk to this one.
wren.adviceLine: He's nobody. A drifter. He'll say strange things to get a rise out of you. Door, Sam. Now.

after.serve: You gave it coffee. You listened to it. What did it tell you?
after.turnAway: Good. Good. Whatever he said, he says it to everyone.
after.break: Don't go near the mirror tonight. Promise me.

serve.text: Professional courtesy. I appreciate it. Ask her what's in the storeroom.

turnAway.text: Of course. But ask her what's in the storeroom. Ask her who.

shelter.text: In with them? Ha. No. But thank you for the offer of a tour.

break.text: You get it. You're doing so well. Go and look in a mirror, Sam. A proper look.
He leaves without using the door.
